description: Every weekday evening, takes each Xero bank account's balance today against its closing balance on the previous business day (Friday on a Monday) and the transactions in between — the same figures as the Bank Balance Change tile. AI explains in plain English what moved each balance and flags anything worth a second look. The report goes to Reports as a web page, is filed in Knowledge as a PDF under Banking/Reports, and is emailed as an attachment. Read-only in Xero.

# ── Have AI explain, in plain English, what moved the balances ──
import json
import re

# The AI step's input cap is 32,000 characters including the prompt, so the brief is trimmed well inside it.
MAX_INPUT = 24000
SHORT_INPUT = 6000
# Transactions sent per account. A day with more than this is summarised by its largest movements.
MAX_TXNS = 40

WRITE_PROMPT = (
    "You are writing the daily bank balance note for the owner of an Australian small business. "
    "The figures come from their Xero bank accounts: each account's balance at the close of the previous "
    "business day, its balance today, and every transaction in between.\n"
    "Write for someone who is not an accountant. Short sentences, plain English, no jargon and no "
    "accounting lecture. Amounts are Australian dollars and are already formatted - quote them exactly as "
    "they appear, never reformat or recalculate them.\n"
    "For each account that moved, say in two or three sentences what moved it: the handful of transactions "
    "that account for most of the change, who they were with, and whether money came in or went out. Name "
    "the real contacts. Do not list every transaction - the report already has the full table underneath.\n"
    "Then give up to four 'watch' points: anything a careful owner would want a second look at, such as a "
    "large or unusual payment, a duplicate-looking pair, bank fees, or an account that has gone negative. "
    "Leave the list empty when nothing stands out - do not invent concerns to fill it.\n"
    "Never state a fact that is not in the data."
)
WRITE_SHAPE = ('{"headline": str, "accounts": [{"name": str, "explanation": str}], "watch": [str]}')

SHORT_PROMPT = (
    "Write one plain-English sentence for the owner of an Australian small business saying how their bank "
    "balances moved since the previous business day. Use the amounts exactly as given. No jargon."
)
SHORT_SHAPE = '{"headline": str}'


def _brief_txn(t):
    return {
        "account_code": str(t.get("accountCode") or ""),
        "coded_to": str(t.get("accountName") or ""),
        "contact": str(t.get("contact") or ""),
        "detail": str(t.get("detail") or ""),
        "amount": str(t.get("amountDisplay") or ""),
        "direction": "out" if float(t.get("amount") or 0) < 0 else "in",
    }


def _by_size(t):
    return -abs(float(t.get("amount") or 0))


change = params.get("change") or {}
problem = str(params.get("problem") or "")
notes = {"headline": "", "accounts": [], "watch": [], "note": ""}

accounts = change.get("accounts") or []
if accounts and not problem:
    brief = {
        "as_at": str((change.get("summary") or {}).get("subtitle") or ""),
        "total_change": str((change.get("summary") or {}).get("totalDifferenceText") or ""),
        "accounts": [],
    }
    for a in accounts:
        txns = sorted(a.get("transactions") or [], key=_by_size)
        brief["accounts"].append({
            "name": str(a.get("name") or ""),
            "previous_balance": str(a.get("previousBalanceText") or ""),
            "previous_day": str(a.get("previousDayText") or ""),
            "balance_today": str(a.get("balanceText") or ""),
            "today": str(a.get("todayText") or ""),
            "change": str(a.get("differenceText") or ""),
            "money_in": str(a.get("moneyInText") or ""),
            "money_out": str(a.get("moneyOutText") or ""),
            "transaction_count": len(a.get("transactions") or []),
            "transactions": [_brief_txn(t) for t in txns[:MAX_TXNS]],
        })

    # A silent fallback here would put the report out with no note at all, so the first failure is kept and
    # a smaller ask is tried before giving up - and if that fails too, the reason is printed on the report.
    written = {}
    try:
        written = api.ai.extract(prompt=WRITE_PROMPT, input=json.dumps(brief)[:MAX_INPUT],
                                 schema_hint=WRITE_SHAPE)
    except Exception as exc:
        reason = str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:120]
        bare = {"as_at": brief["as_at"], "total_change": brief["total_change"],
                "accounts": [{k: v for k, v in a.items() if k != "transactions"} for a in brief["accounts"]]}
        try:
            written = api.ai.extract(prompt=SHORT_PROMPT, input=json.dumps(bare)[:SHORT_INPUT],
                                     schema_hint=SHORT_SHAPE)
        except Exception:
            written = {}
            notes["note"] = ("AI couldn't write the explanation (" + reason +
                             "). The figures below are straight from Xero and are unaffected.")

    written = written if isinstance(written, dict) else {}
    notes["headline"] = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(written.get("headline") or "")).strip()
    known = {str(a.get("name") or "") for a in accounts}
    for row in written.get("accounts") or []:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            continue
        name = str(row.get("name") or "")
        text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(row.get("explanation") or "")).strip()
        # Only keep an explanation that names an account Xero actually returned.
        if name in known and text:
            notes["accounts"].append({"name": name, "explanation": text})
    notes["watch"] = [re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(w)).strip()[:200]
                      for w in (written.get("watch") or []) if str(w).strip()][:4]

summary = problem or notes["note"] or (
    notes["headline"] or "Wrote the explanation for " + str(len(notes["accounts"])) + " account(s).")

LOGO_H = 11.0 LOGO_W = 60.0 # The whole PDF is base64'd into the mail connector's request, and a logo straight out of a design tool can # be megabytes. It is drawn 11mm tall, so a few hundred pixels is every pixel it can show. LOGO_PX = (960, 240) LOGO_BYTES = 120_000 # Transactions printed per account. Beyond this the table would run for pages; the rest are counted instead. MAX_ROWS = 60 NAVY = (22, 37, 64) GOLD = (176, 141, 87) GREEN = (29, 115, 80) RED = (176, 44, 44) INK = (33, 37, 41) GREY = (110, 114, 120) LINE = (222, 220, 214) PAPER = (244, 242, 237) WHITE = (255, 255, 255) def safe(s): """Core PDF fonts are Latin-1 only.""" s = str(s or "") for a, b in (("–", "-"), ("—", "-"), ("‘", "'"), ("’", "'"), ("“", '"'), ("”", '"'), ("•", "-"), ("…", "..."), ("→", "->"), ("·", "-"), ("▲", "+"), ("▼", "-"), ("≈", "~"), (" ", " ")): s = s.replace(a, b) return s.encode("latin-1", "ignore").decode("latin-1") def esc(s): return (str(s or "").replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">") .replace('"', """)) def d_fmt(iso): """dd-Mmm-yy, for the file name and the email subject.""" if not iso: return "" y, m, d = iso[:10].split("-") return d + "-" + MONTHS[int(m) - 1] + "-" + y[2:] def money(n): return "A$" + format(abs(float(n or 0)), ",.2f") def tone_rgb(direction): return GREEN if direction == "up" else (RED if direction == "down" else GREY) def tone_css(direction): return "#1d7350" if direction == "up" else ("#b02c2c" if direction == "down" else "#6e7278") def moved(account): return abs(float(account.get("difference") or 0)) >= 0.005 change = params.get("change") or {} notes = params.get("notes") or {} problem = str(params.get("problem") or "") business = str(params.get("business_name") or "").strip() # The Xero organisation the figures were read from, straight from the connector. business_name is free text # someone typed, so it can name any org; this cannot. org_name = str(params.get("org_name") or "").strip() source_line = "Xero organisation: " + org_name if org_name else "Xero organisation not identified" to = [a.strip() for a in str(params.get("email_to") or "").replace(";", ",").split(",") if a.strip()] head = change.get("summary") or {} accounts = change.get("accounts") or [] by_name = {} for row in notes.get("accounts") or []: by_name[str(row.get("name") or "")] = str(row.get("explanation") or "") # The business's logo, where one has been put in Knowledge. A logo that will not load is said so in the # summary and the name is set instead - a missing picture is no reason to lose the report. logo_file = str(params.get("logo_file") or "").strip() logo_path = "" logo_uri = "" logo_size = (0, 0) logo_note = "" if logo_file: try: with open(str(api.files.get(file=logo_file)), "rb") as fh: img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(fh.read())) img.load() img.thumbnail(LOGO_PX) buf = io.BytesIO() img.save(buf, format="PNG", optimize=True) kind, ext = "image/png", ".png" if buf.tell() > LOGO_BYTES and img.mode in ("RGB", "L"): buf = io.BytesIO() img.save(buf, format="JPEG", quality=85, optimize=True) kind, ext = "image/jpeg", ".jpg" logo_raw = buf.getvalue() logo_size = img.size logo_path = api.files.scratch_path("logo" + ext) with open(logo_path, "wb") as fh: fh.write(logo_raw) logo_uri = "data:" + kind + ";base64," + base64.b64encode(logo_raw).decode("ascii") except Exception as exc: logo_path = "" logo_uri = "" logo_note = " The logo was left off: " + logo_file + " wouldn't load (" + \ str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:120] + ")." report_file = "" report_link = "" emailed_to = "" sent = "" filed = "" if problem or not accounts: summary = problem or "Nothing to report." else: today = date.today().isoformat() title_name = business or org_name or "Bank Balance Change" # -- Drawing helpers pdf.set_line_width(width) pdf.line(x, y, x + w, y) def write(x, y, w, text, size=8.0, lh=3.8, color=INK, style="", align="L"): font(size, style, color=color) pdf.set_xy(x, y) lines = pdf.multi_cell(w, the wording around them is " "written with the help of AI."] try: api.connectors.invoke(server=MAIL, tool="send_email", args={ "to": to, "subject": "Bank balance change: " + str(head.get("totalDifferenceText") or "") + " (" + d_fmt(today) + ")", "body": "\n".join(lines), "attachments": [{"name": title + ".pdf", "contentBase64": base64.b64encode(data).decode(), "contentType": "application/pdf"}], }) emailed_to = ", ".join(to) sent = " and emailed it to " + emailed_to except Exception as exc: sent = ", but couldn't email it (" + str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:200] + ")" else: sent = " (no address was given, so it wasn't emailed)" summary = "Saved " + report_file + filed + sent + "." + logo_note
